data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ActiveSafetyHolds
data.value: Distinct active safety holds on visible work orders for the selected unit. This diagnostic cannot release a hold or certify the absence of other restrictions.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.AutoSetStatusForShiftDispatchPersonnel
data.value: Current shift-dispatch automatic-status setting (1 means enabled). A configured rule does not prove it ran during this window.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.CapabilityAccess
data.value: Current module, feature and owning access gates were checked for this administrator. This is separate from the selected member’s action permission and session.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ChannelFailure
data.value: A send service or provider recorded a failure or decline for at least one channel attempt. This does not prove that every channel failed. Inspect the attempt and the source communication settings.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ChannelSkipped
data.value: A recorded channel attempt was skipped. The trace reason describes that decision; another route may still have sent.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.DeliveryUnknown
data.value: No authenticated delivery or acknowledgement receipt is available in this capture path. Provider acceptance must not be interpreted as receipt by a responder.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.DisabledAutoAvailable
data.value: Current automatic-availability setting (1 means disabled). The owning one-hour availability projection may affect what users see without a new status row.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EffectivePermission
data.value: The supported action was checked through its current permission policy. Resource group locks require the specific target; unsupported combinations remain unknown. Review roles and permission rows.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EnableTextToCall
data.value: Current text-to-call switch. A disabled switch can explain text intake only; it does not diagnose email, CAD or API imports.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.Entitlement
data.value: Current add-on metadata is checked separately from permissions. A denied source does not prove an add-on is missing; unavailable billing remains unknown.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EquipmentReadiness
data.value: The equipment evidence source was unavailable or restricted. Do not infer readiness from missing check or hold data.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EquipmentRelease
data.value: Calibration, parts, assignments and the authorized return-to-service decision require the owning maintenance records. No automatic release is performed.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.FailedChecks
data.value: Recorded failed unit checks in the selected window. A later repair or completed check must be verified in the owning records.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.HistoricalTrace
data.value: Trace coverage is measured from recorded attempt sequences. Missing starts, completions, sequence gaps or dropped events leave the attempt incomplete.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ImportAcceptance
data.value: End-to-end received/parsed/imported history is not available for all intake providers. Review the owning parser and provider logs using a non-sensitive reference.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.LocalMinimum
data.value: The locally required staffing minimum and site-specific qualification policy have not been established. An empty or non-empty roster cannot certify coverage.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MaintenanceReadiness
data.value: Maintenance evidence is unavailable or restricted. Free checklist evidence is evaluated separately; missing maintenance data does not certify readiness.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MapClientScope
data.value: This check uses the v4 map policy. Tracker connectivity, other clients and historical location visibility still require their owning diagnostics.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MapMarker
data.value: The current v4 map selection policy was evaluated for this resource without returning coordinates. Review marker TTL, status location and location visibility.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MemberActive
data.value: Current membership or assignment eligibility may block access or paging. Review disabled and removed membership on the personnel screen.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.NotSelected
data.value: The complete recorded routing attempt did not select this member. Review the call recipients, group, role, unit crew and shift routing used for that attempt.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.OverdueChecks
data.value: Expected unit checks in the selected window that remain overdue and neither completed nor skipped. Review the owning checklist before relying on the unit.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.OverdueMaintenance
data.value: Visible open work orders for this unit whose due date has passed. Inspect the maintenance record for assignment, parts and the authorized return-to-service decision.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PagingPreferences
data.value: Current dispatch preferences and verified contact flags determine the eligible SMS, email and push channels. Review the member profile; present eligibility does not prove historical delivery.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PersonnelOnUnitSetUnitStatus
data.value: Current personnel-on-unit propagation setting (1 means enabled). Review unit crew and type overrides before attributing a transition.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PingAge
data.value: Recorded location ping age, in minutes, is compared with the current TTL. A status location may still supply a marker after a ping expires.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PlatformTelemetry
data.value: Platform queue depth, retry state, credentials and all external success/error history are not available here. Use the owning integration history or download a reviewed support bundle.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PushDeviceHealth
data.value: Push registration and last-seen health are not established by this trace. Review the device in the owning application and use the existing communication test deliberately.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.QualificationGaps
data.value: Members of the selected role who do not meet its recorded qualification requirements as of today. This is a count, not a disclosure of certificate or personnel content.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.QualifiedRoster
data.value: Current on-duty roster members who meet the selected role’s recorded qualification requirements, optionally limited to the selected roster group. Approved trades are resolved by the owning roster builder.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ResponseAvailability
data.value: Scheduled and qualified staff are not guaranteed responders. Confirm actual availability and concurrent commitments through the owning operations process.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.RosterOverlap
data.value: People assigned more than once across the current resolved roster. Review overlapping shifts, groups and approved trades before assuming they can cover concurrent work.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ScheduledRoleVacancies
data.value: Unfilled slots for the selected role in currently active shift schedules, optionally limited to the selected group. These schedule targets do not establish an operational staffing minimum.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.SessionFreshness
data.value: A different member’s live session claims are not supplied to this diagnostic. Use the normal sign-out/sign-in or approved session recovery flow after checking account and access policy; do not share credentials.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ShiftCallDispatchPersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Current shift-dispatch personnel status code. This is current configuration, not evidence of a past transition.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ShiftCallReleasePersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Current shift-release personnel status code. This is current configuration, not evidence of a past transition.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.StatusHistory
data.value: Number of recorded status transitions in the selected window, bounded to 100. An absent row is not proof that a scheduled automation did not run.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.StatusWriterUnknown
data.value: The selected status rows do not record the transition writer. A destination-decision source must not be mislabeled as the cause of a status change.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.UnitCallDispatchStatusToSet
data.value: Current unit-dispatch status code. Unit-type overrides and the owning dispatch path must also be checked.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.UnitCallReleaseStatusToSet
data.value: Current unit-release status code. Unit-type overrides and the owning release path must also be checked.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.emailImportFailureCount
data.value: Count of configured email sources marked failed. Review the import source configuration and its owning error report; credentials and error bodies are excluded.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.emailImportSourceCount
data.value: Count of configured email import sources. Zero only identifies missing email configuration; it says nothing about other intake channels.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.failedWorkflowCount
data.value: Current failed workflow runs in the last seven days, under your workflow-run permission. This is department-wide context, not proof of the selected feature’s cause.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.importHeartbeatMissing
data.value: Compare the last recorded email poll with the expected interval in the operating profile. Missing or future poll timestamps cannot establish a healthy poller.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.overdueRecordReviewCount
data.value: Current overdue record reviews visible to you. This is administrative context, not proof of report execution failure.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.textSourcePresent
data.value: Current presence of a text source allowlist. Presence is not proof that a particular sender matches or that its message was parsed.

data.name: PackGap.fire

data.name: PackGap.industrial

data.name: PackGap.mental-health

data.name: PackGap.mutual-aid

data.name: PackGap.sar
data.value: The pack can flag configured roster gaps, credentials and overdue equipment checks. Search-sector coverage, terrain access, radio coverage, external resource location, missing-person case handling and mission suitability require their owning systems and a search-service reviewer.

data.name: PackGap.security

data.name: RuleWhy.admin-enrollment
data.value: Enforcement settings alone do not prove that every administrator has enrolled.

data.name: RuleWhy.admin-mfa
data.value: Administrative accounts control department access and configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.admin-succession
data.value: A single administrative account can make recovery difficult.

data.name: RuleWhy.checkin-timers
data.value: Automatic timers need applicable target configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.checklist-overdue
data.value: Recorded overdue checks need an owner and follow-up.

data.name: RuleWhy.command-sources
data.value: Both text calls and commands are selected without dispatch-source patterns. Member commands use verified identity; the patterns distinguish dispatch senders rather than granting every member permission.

data.name: RuleWhy.communication-tests
data.value: Configuration and device registration do not prove delivery.

data.name: RuleWhy.continuity-reference
data.value: The reviewed operating profile has no reference to a continuity or fallback procedure. The procedure may exist elsewhere; this is an administrative review prompt.

data.name: RuleWhy.credential-expiry
data.value: Expiring qualifications may affect upcoming assignments.

data.name: RuleWhy.email-import-failures
data.value: One or more configured mailboxes currently report a failed polling state. This is the latest stored observation, not proof of a continuing provider outage.

data.name: RuleWhy.empty-groups
data.value: An empty group has no members to receive its work.

data.name: RuleWhy.equipment-holds
data.value: Only the owning workflow can release a safety hold.

data.name: RuleWhy.import-heartbeat
data.value: Mailbox polling is compared with the interval declared in the operating profile. Missing calls alone do not imply an outage; absent or future poll timestamps remain unknown.

data.name: RuleWhy.map-style
data.value: An enabled map override needs a style configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.map-token
data.value: An enabled map override needs its provider credentials.

data.name: RuleWhy.notification-channels
data.value: Some visible active members have no eligible SMS, email or push preference under the ordinary notification sender. Push preference alone is not a valid registration or proof of delivery.

data.name: RuleWhy.notification-profiles
data.value: Missing member profiles prevent a complete channel eligibility assessment. Unknown eligibility must not be treated as no available channel.

data.name: RuleWhy.password-recovery
data.value: Sending a single-use recovery link avoids an administrator choosing a member password.

data.name: RuleWhy.person-location-age
data.value: A zero location lifetime can keep stale personnel positions on the map.

data.name: RuleWhy.personnel-limit
data.value: Adding members may exceed the current plan limit.

data.name: RuleWhy.policy-expiry
data.value: A linked staffing, qualification or continuity document is scheduled for removal within 30 days. This is document metadata, not a legal or clinical review deadline.

data.name: RuleWhy.policy-references
data.value: A declared policy document was removed, expired or is no longer in this department. Existence alone does not prove policy approval or suitability.

data.name: RuleWhy.qualified-coverage
data.value: Coverage follows approved local qualification and role requirements.

data.name: RuleWhy.record-review
data.value: Recorded due dates need administrative follow-up.

data.name: RuleWhy.run-cards
data.value: Enabled recommendations need reviewed run-card configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-auto-without-dispatch
data.value: Automatic shift status changes need shift dispatch enabled.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-coverage
data.value: An empty shift can cause group dispatch to fall back to every group member.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-open-slots
data.value: Resolved rosters do not fill every configured role slot in the next seven days.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-overlaps

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-trades

data.value: Recorded lot expiry can affect supply availability.

data.name: SettingHelp.AllowSignupsForMultipleShiftGroups
data.value: Allow a member to sign up for multiple shift groups. Review overlaps and local coverage rules separately.

data.name: SettingHelp.AutoSetStatusForShiftDispatchPersonnel
data.value: Apply the configured status to shift-dispatched personnel. This only takes effect with shift dispatch enabled.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardHideUnavailable
data.value: Hide unavailable resources on the Big Board; this affects visibility, not their dispatch eligibility.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardMapCenterAddress
data.value: Address used to center the Big Board. Address details remain on their owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardMapCenterGpsCoordinates
data.value: Explicit board-center coordinates take precedence over address geocoding. Partial coordinates do not overwrite the saved center.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardMapZoomLevel
data.value: Initial Big Board map zoom. An unset override lets the consuming board select its default.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardPageRefresh
data.value: Big Board refresh interval. Review load and the age of displayed information before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.BrainTreeCustomerId
data.value: Legacy billing reference. Use the subscription provider workflow, not a direct settings edit.

data.name: SettingHelp.CallsSortOrder
data.value: Sort order for displayed calls; does not reorder provider delivery or change call priority.

data.name: SettingHelp.CheckInTimersAutoEnableForNewCalls
data.value: Automatically start configured check-in timers for new calls. Review timer targets and escalation before enabling it.

data.name: SettingHelp.DepartmentOperatingProfile
data.value: Declared organization, workforce, dispatch, seasonal, language and policy context. Recommendations never infer licenses or clinical scope from this profile.

data.name: SettingHelp.DisabledAutoAvailable
data.value: Disables automatic availability behavior. Review staffing/status reset interactions before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRecommendationAutoDispatch
data.value: Allow the recommendation path to dispatch automatically where enabled. Preview recipients and verify local procedures first.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig
data.value: Location, ETA, rest, crew and move-up settings used by recommendation consumers. External ETA calls occur only in the owning operational flow.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRecommendationMode
data.value: Dispatch recommendation selection mode. Review run cards, eligible resources and human dispatch responsibility.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchShiftInsteadOfGroup
data.value: Expand dispatched groups using the resolved on-duty roster. An empty shift result falls back to group members; preview both cases.

data.name: SettingHelp.EnableModernNotifications
data.value: Use supported modern notification behavior. Verify each consumer and channel; provider acceptance is not delivery.

data.name: SettingHelp.EnableTextCommand
data.value: Configured text-command preference. Dispatch-source patterns and verified member command identity are different checks. Provider and chatbot paths do not enforce this switch uniformly; review the active consumer before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.EnableTextToCall
data.value: Configured text-call preference. Enforcement differs by provider and chatbot path; the stored value alone does not prove intake is stopped or accepted. Review sender classification and perform an explicit controlled verification on the owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.ForceChatbotSecurityPin
data.value: Require the member security PIN for sensitive supported chatbot and SMS actions, including members who have not opted in.

data.name: SettingHelp.GroupDispatchScopeConfig
data.value: Group-subtree dispatch visibility with explicit role exceptions. Preview each actor and target scope before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.HardwareTrackingLocationRetentionDays
data.value: Tracking retention bounded by host configuration and applicable holds. Shortening retention can make data eligible for deletion.

data.name: SettingHelp.HardwareTrackingMobileFallbackEnabled
data.value: Use supported mobile location fallback when hardware data is stale. Verify each device/source rather than assuming continuous tracking.

data.name: SettingHelp.HardwareTrackingStaleAfterSeconds
data.value: Age at which a hardware location becomes stale, clamped to at least one second. Review device reporting intervals.

data.name: SettingHelp.InternalDispatchEmail
data.value: Assigned internal dispatch email address. Presence can be shown; the address stays on the authorized import screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingMapboxAccessToken
data.value: Map-provider access token. Only presence is reported. Disabling the override deletes it and requires re-entry to restore.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingMapboxStyleUrl
data.value: Custom map style reference. Verify the provider style and credential together; disabling the override deletes this value.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingPersonnelAllowStatusWithNoLocationToOverwrite
data.value: Allow a personnel status without a location to replace the previous location-bearing state. This can remove a marker.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingPersonnelLocationTTL
data.value: Maximum personnel location age in minutes. Zero keeps stale positions visible without an age limit; assess actual ping ages.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingUnitAllowStatusWithNoLocationToOverwrite
data.value: Allow a unit status without a location to overwrite earlier location data. Check hardware and app updates together.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingUnitLocationTTL
data.value: Maximum unit location age in minutes. Zero retains stale unit locations indefinitely in supported map consumers.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingUseMapboxOverride
data.value: Use the department map provider override. Turning it off on the owning screen removes the stored style and token.

data.name: SettingHelp.ModuleSettings
data.value: Controls module navigation and supported feature gates. Hiding a module does not delete its records or prove independent dispatch settings are disabled.

data.name: SettingHelp.NewCallFieldPolicy
data.value: Controls optional new-call fields across supported clients. Hidden fields cannot be required; core dispatch fields remain mandatory.

data.name: SettingHelp.PaddleCustomerId
data.value: Billing-provider customer reference. Managed by authorized billing flows and never returned in assistant evidence.

data.name: SettingHelp.PersonnelListStatusSortOrder
data.value: Custom ordering of personnel statuses in lists. Review all configured statuses before replacing the order.

data.name: SettingHelp.PersonnelOnUnitSetUnitStatus
data.value: Allow personnel status updates to influence their assigned unit status. Review automation and crew assignment together.

data.name: SettingHelp.PersonnelSortOrder
data.value: Sort order for personnel lists; does not change availability, access or dispatch priority.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsDefaultLifecyclePreset
data.value: Default lifecycle for new department-owned definitions. Locked definitions retain their own lifecycle.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsDisclosureConfig
data.value: Disclosure review clock, redaction profile and release approver. Review local obligations through the authorized disclosure workflow.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsGroupScopeConfig
data.value: Reserved identifier with no editable behavior in this release. Do not present it as a shipped setting.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsGroupVisibilityMode
data.value: Whether record visibility is department-wide or group scoped. Group scope narrows existing permission and never grants access.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig
data.value: Number assignment, year reset and sequence formatting for definitions that do not override the department configuration.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy
data.value: Default and definition-specific retention, including prior-policy history. Holds and restricted-class rules can prevent purge eligibility.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsReviewDueHours
data.value: Default administrative review deadline; a definition-level override takes precedence. This is not a statutory deadline inference.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsSearchConfig
data.value: Allowed record search scope and protected-data behavior. Search access remains bounded by current source permissions.

data.name: SettingHelp.Require2FAForAdmins
data.value: Administrator MFA requirement mode. Verify actual factors and recovery for each administrator before enforcement changes.

data.name: SettingHelp.RequirePasswordResetViaEmail
data.value: Use single-use recovery links for administrator-initiated member password resets, instead of selecting a replacement password.

data.name: SettingHelp.RssFeedKeyForActiveCalls
data.value: Credential for the active-call feed. Treat the feed and its key as sensitive; rotate through its owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.ShiftCallDispatchPersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Personnel status applied when shift dispatch occurs. Minus one leaves status unchanged; use an existing approved status.

data.name: SettingHelp.ShiftCallReleasePersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Personnel status applied on call release for the shift-dispatch path. Minus one leaves status unchanged.

data.name: SettingHelp.StaffingSuppressStaffingLevels
data.value: Staffing levels suppressed in supported notifications. Suppression can change who hears an alert and is not evidence of delivery.

data.name: SettingHelp.StripeCustomerId
data.value: Billing-provider customer reference managed by subscription workflows; never edit this as an ordinary department setting.

data.name: SettingHelp.TestEnabled
data.value: Department testing behavior. Do not treat enabling a test setting as proof of production readiness.

data.name: SettingHelp.TextToCallImportFormat
data.value: Parser used for inbound text call creation. Verify the sender format with a controlled example on the owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.TextToCallNumber
data.value: Provisioned inbound text number. Provisioning has external effects and must use the normal text settings flow.

data.name: SettingHelp.TextToCallSourceNumbers
data.value: Allowed inbound source numbers for text calls and commands. Empty sources prevent accepted intake; never display raw numbers in Admin Assist.

data.name: SettingHelp.TtsLanguage
data.value: Text-to-speech language for supported voice notifications. Confirm supported voices and pronunciation with a human-run test.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitCallDispatchStatusToSet
data.value: Unit status applied during call dispatch. Minus one or an invalid built-in unit status leaves the status unchanged.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitCallReleaseStatusToSet
data.value: Unit status applied at call release. Review unit-type overrides before assuming one department-wide effect.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitCallStatusOverridesByUnitType
data.value: Per-unit-type call status overrides. Existing type-specific values take precedence over department defaults.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitDispatchAlsoDispatchToAssignedPersonnel
data.value: Expand unit dispatch to its assigned crew. Review duplicate routes, current assignments and recipient permissions.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitDispatchAlsoDispatchToGroup
data.value: Expand unit dispatch to the station group. This can substantially increase the recipient audience.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitStatusThresholds
data.value: Visual warning thresholds for time in a unit status. A highlight does not change the unit status or certify availability.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitsSortOrder
data.value: Sort order for unit lists; does not change unit eligibility or dispatch recommendation ranking.

data.name: SettingHelp.UpdateTimestamp
data.value: Internal configuration timestamp. Read-only metadata, not an administrator-editable preference.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertAutoMessageSchedule
data.value: Schedule for automatic weather messaging. Review the department time zone, overnight periods and daylight-saving changes.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertAutoMessageSeverity
data.value: Minimum weather severity eligible for automatic messages. Review recipients, schedule and duplicate suppression.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertCacheMinutes
data.value: Weather cache duration; longer caching changes freshness and provider load.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertCallIntegration
data.value: Include supported weather context in call integration. It does not certify weather or route safety.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertExcludedEvents
data.value: Weather event types excluded from configured processing. Review exclusions against approved local procedures.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertMinimumSeverity
data.value: Minimum severity eligible for the weather-alert view. Severity values come from the weather service, not local incident triage.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertsEnabled
data.value: Enable supported weather-alert processing. Configure zones and communication behavior before relying on it.

data.name: SetupEvidence.checkin-setup
data.value: Check-in timer configuration is recorded. Verify target selection, deadlines, escalation ownership and a controlled scenario through the owning screen.

data.name: SetupEvidence.email-intake
data.value: Mailbox configuration and available polling metadata are checked. Parser success, routing and page delivery require a controlled authorized test.

data.name: SetupEvidence.groups
data.value: Checks recorded group membership and station location metadata. Review intended dispatch and site coverage separately.

data.name: SetupEvidence.personnel
data.value: Current active members are recorded. This does not verify invitations, account access, role assignment or qualifications.

data.name: SetupEvidence.run-cards
data.value: Run-card records are present. The listed check verifies presence when recommendations are enabled, not correctness of local response requirements.

data.name: SetupEvidence.units
data.value: Checks recorded unit types and groups. Crew suitability, device setup and actual communications need separate verification.

data.name: SetupEvidence.weather
data.value: Weather zones are recorded. Confirm geographic coverage and the actual provider and notification path.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.AllowDispatchViaChatbot
data.value: Permits supported chatbot dispatch actions subject to their own authorization and confirmation. Enabling it may allow real calls and pages.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.AllowedPlatforms
data.value: Allowed chatbot platform codes; the stored asterisk represents the platform default. Review each connected provider and its account-linking requirements.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.IsEnabled
data.value: Department chatbot availability. Platform feature rollout, account linking and action permissions are separate gates.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.LlmApiEndpoint
data.value: Optional existing chatbot model endpoint. Phase 0 Admin Assist does not call it and does not use chatbot configuration as an AI entitlement.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.LlmApiKey
data.value: Credential for the chatbot model provider. Never copy it into setup metadata or public reference content.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.LlmModelName
data.value: Model identifier used by the existing chatbot integration. This is separate from the later Admin Assist open-source inference deployment.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.MaxSessionsPerUser
data.value: Maximum chatbot sessions per member in supported consumers. This is separate from authenticated web/mobile session limits.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.MessagesPerDepartmentPerMinute
data.value: Optional department chatbot rate bound. Consider shared demand and provider quotas before changing it.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.MessagesPerUserPerMinute
data.value: Optional per-member chatbot rate bound. Review provider limits and burst behavior; this is not a delivery guarantee.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.ProactiveNotificationsEnabled
data.value: Allows supported proactive chatbot notifications. Recipient permissions, channel configuration and sending workflows remain authoritative.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.RequireConfirmationForStatusChange
data.value: Requests confirmation for supported status changes. Review each platform consumer before assuming all commands are covered.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.RequireLinkingConfirmation
data.value: Requires confirmation in the supported account-linking flow. Linking must not bypass verified identity or departmental authorization.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.SessionTtlMinutes
data.value: Chatbot session lifetime in minutes. Expiry does not revoke an unrelated Resgrid sign-in session.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.AddressId
data.value: Department address reference. Review the owning address and mapping consumers; it is separate from station and site addresses.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.ApiKey
data.value: Department API credential. Never place it in setup notes or model input; manage and rotate it through the authorized workflow.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.Code
data.value: Department code used by supported identification and access flows. Review those consumers before changing it.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.DepartmentType
data.value: Legacy organization-type label. The operating profile provides multiple sectors; neither establishes clinical scope or response qualifications.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.LinkCode
data.value: Department linking code. Review who can use a link and rotate it using the owning workflow.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.ManagingUserId
data.value: Managing-member identity. Subscription and high-risk account operations may require this member; change ownership through its explicit owning workflow.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.Name
data.value: Department display name. Review member-facing labels and documents that snapshot the name; changing it does not rename historical artifacts.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.PublicApiKey
data.value: Credential used by supported public API consumers. Public in the field name does not make credential disclosure safe.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.SharedSecret
data.value: Department integration secret. Rotation can affect integrations and needs coordinated verification.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.IsFailure
data.value: Latest recorded mailbox failure flag. Verify a new poll before treating it as a continuing outage or a resolved problem.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.LastCheck
data.value: Last recorded polling timestamp. Missing or future timestamps are unknown; quiet call volume is not proof of a poll failure.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Password
data.value: Mailbox credential. Do not copy it into Admin Assist; rotate it through the mailbox and owning editor together.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Port
data.value: Mailbox connection port. It must match the selected provider and TLS mode.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.UseSsl
data.value: Mailbox transport encryption option. Verify actual provider compatibility and successful polling; a stored flag alone does not prove transport protection.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Username
data.value: Mailbox account identifier used for intake. It remains on the authorized configuration screen.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.BeforeData
data.value: Previous-state filter for applicable events. Review valid status IDs and the event-specific interpretation of an empty or wildcard value.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.CurrentData
data.value: Current-state filter for applicable events. Compare it with the previous-state filter to avoid unintended volume.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.Data
data.value: Event-specific configuration payload. The owning editor validates its meaning; Admin Assist does not execute arbitrary stored expressions.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.DepartmentAdmins
data.value: Includes department administrators in supported notification processing. Review overlap and channel eligibility before estimating volume.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.Disabled
data.value: Stored disabled marker. The inspected legacy notification processor does not consult this flag, so it must not be treated as a verified stop switch. Review the active consumer; queued and delivered notifications cannot be recalled.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.EventType
data.value: Event that can trigger this notification rule. Match the event to a real administrative responsibility and expected frequency.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.Everyone
data.value: Selects the department-wide recipient option. Review actual active membership, suppression and deduplication before use.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.GroupsToNotify
data.value: Department-group recipients. Review group membership and lock-to-group behavior together.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.LockToGroup
data.value: Restricts applicable event processing to group scope. Review the selected event's actual source group and recipient resolver.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.LowerLimit
data.value: Lower threshold for event-specific alerts. Use approved local thresholds and verify the actual event interpretation.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.RolesToNotify
data.value: Personnel-role recipients. Role membership can change; a role label is not a qualification or delivery guarantee.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.SelectedGroupsAdminsOnly
data.value: Limits selected-group recipients to their administrators in supported event paths. It does not designate department administrators automatically.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.UpperLimit
data.value: Upper threshold for event-specific alerts. Units and comparisons depend on the selected event.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.UsersToNotify
data.value: Explicit member recipients. Membership and channel eligibility are evaluated separately at send time.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowedIpRanges
data.value: Allowed login network ranges. Empty adds no range restriction. Review legitimate responder networks and recovery access before narrowing it.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.DataClassificationLevel
data.value: Department classification label. Selecting it does not enroll ADP, establish compliance or automatically classify every record correctly.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.MaxConcurrentSessions
data.value: Maximum policy-managed concurrent sessions per user; zero means unlimited for this setting. Existing sessions and enforcement rollout must be checked separately.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.MinPasswordLength
data.value: Minimum length offered by the policy editor. Actual password validators and supported credential-change paths remain authoritative.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.PasswordExpirationDays
data.value: Password age in days; zero disables this policy's age limit. Verify local-password and SSO behavior separately.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.RequireMfa
data.value: Department-wide MFA policy, distinct from the administrator-only setting. Review enrollment, supported factors and recovery before enforcement.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.RequirePasswordComplexity
data.value: Stored complexity preference. Consumer and editor coverage must be verified before relying on this field; it is not proof that an existing password meets a rule.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.RequireSso
data.value: Requires the supported SSO policy gate. Verify the active identity provider and local recovery arrangements before removing a sign-in path.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.SessionTimeoutMinutes
data.value: Idle timeout in minutes; zero defers to host behavior. Verify policy-managed sessions and each supported client rather than assuming immediate global logout.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AllowLocalLogin
data.value: Allows a local-password path alongside this provider where policy permits. Review the department-wide SSO requirement and recovery plan together.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AssertionConsumerServiceUrl
data.value: Stored SAML callback configuration. Use the endpoint supplied by the owning SSO setup and verify the provider registration.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AttributeMappingJson
data.value: Maps provider attributes to supported member fields. Validate identity matching and missing attributes with an approved test account.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.Authority
data.value: OIDC issuer or authority. Verify the intended tenant, discovery metadata and callback registration before enabling it.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AutoProvisionUsers
data.value: Allows the supported sign-in flow to create members. Review identity matching, capacity and default assignments before enabling it.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.ClientId
data.value: Client registration identifier from the identity provider. Keep tenant and audience registration consistent with the owning SSO flow.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.DefaultRankId
data.value: Department rank assigned by supported automatic provisioning. It does not grant permissions or prove qualifications.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedClientSecret
data.value: Encrypted provider client secret. The secret is entered and rotated on the authorized provider editor; Admin Assist only describes its purpose.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedIdpCertificate
data.value: Encrypted provider verification certificate material. Review expiry and rotation through SSO; this description is not certificate validation.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedScimBearerToken
data.value: Encrypted credential for inbound SCIM requests. Rotate through the explicit token workflow and update the provider before retiring an old credential.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedSigningCertificate
data.value: Encrypted signing certificate and private-key material. Do not copy it into notes, logs or assistant messages.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EntityId
data.value: SAML service-provider identifier registered at the identity provider. It must agree with the configured integration.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.IsEnabled
data.value: Makes this provider configuration available to the supported SSO flow. A saved enabled flag is not a successful sign-in test.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.MetadataUrl
data.value: SAML provider metadata location. Review the trusted provider and its current signing material through the SSO editor.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.ScimEnabled
data.value: Enables supported SCIM provisioning for this configuration. Review identity lifecycle, deactivation and token access separately from interactive sign-in.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.SsoProviderType
data.value: Selects the identity protocol and provider configuration. OIDC and SAML have different metadata, certificates and callback requirements.
